port.description: HTTP server listen port. Overridden by the ROUTERLLM_PORT environment variable.

cooldown.description: How long a key is skipped after a dead response (401/402/403). Go duration syntax; compound values like 1h30m are allowed.

force_stream.description: Always serve /v1/chat/completions responses as Anthropic-style SSE, regardless of the client's stream flag.

dedupe_tools.description: Drop duplicate outbound tool definitions (same function name, first wins) on every leg. A leg's own dedupe_tools still works when this is off.

clamp_tool_schemas.description: Flatten outbound tool schemas nested deeper than tool_schema_max_depth on every leg. Upstreams reject the whole request when one tool nests too deep (OpenCode: 10 levels). A leg's own clamp_tool_schemas still works when this is off.

tool_schema_max_depth.description: Depth budget for the tool-schema clamp. Counts nested schema levels; the node at the budget is replaced by a stub keeping type/description.

allow_client_headers.description: If specified, only these client headers are forwarded (case-insensitive; hop-by-hop headers are always blocked).

system_prompt_file.description: Path to a file whose contents are prepended as a system message.

system_prompt_file_opencode.description: Path to a file whose contents are prepended as the leading system message on style: opencode legs only.

settings.description: Tunables that used to be hardcoded. Every key is optional; an absent key keeps its built-in default, and an absent block is equivalent to the defaults.

limits.description: Request and response payload bounds. Hot-reloadable.

request_body_bytes.description: Largest client request body buffered per request. Applies to /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/messages.

error_body_bytes.description: How much of an upstream error body is read for logging and telemetry.

brief_body_bytes.description: How much of a request body is echoed into trace lines.

upstream_tools.description: Tool-definition cap enforced before dispatch. Gateways reject larger requests; 128 is the OpenAI/DeepSeek ceiling.

schema_max_depth.description: Depth budget for the tool-schema clamp when clamp_tool_schemas is on and tool_schema_max_depth is unset. Stays below the gateways' limit of 10.

media.description: Bounds for resolving media references before dispatch.

resolved_size_bytes.description: Largest single media reference the proxy will fetch.

refs_per_request.description: How many media references one request may resolve.

bytes_per_request.description: Total media bytes one request may fetch.

redirects.description: Redirect hops allowed per media fetch.

attempts.description: Retries on one key for transient failures (408/429/5xx) before moving to the next key.

backoff_base_ms.description: Exponential backoff base between retries; attempt n waits base * 2^n.

telemetry.description: Event ring, metrics and jsonl persistence. Hot-reloadable; retention only affects the replay.

ring_capacity.description: In-memory event ring size, also the console's request-log ceiling.

retention.description: How far back events are kept and replayed. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

file_bytes.description: Rotate the jsonl once it grows past this many bytes.

rewrite_bytes.description: Cap for a rotation rewrite. Must be smaller than file_bytes; a value at or above it is reset to file_bytes/2.

rotate_retry_interval.description: How long to wait before retrying a rotation that failed. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

bucket_width.description: Width of one metric bucket. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

line_bytes.description: Longest jsonl line the replay will read; longer lines are skipped whole.

field_bytes.description: Clamp for free-form identifier fields (model, request id, attempt note).

error_bytes.description: Clamp for a stored failure detail string.

resp_body_bytes.description: Clamp for a captured upstream error body per event and per attempt.

ttft_reservoir.description: TTFT samples kept per metric bucket.

model_series.description: Per-model metric series cap; the oldest series is evicted.

usage_tail_bytes.description: How much of the previous read is re-scanned so a usage object straddling a read boundary is still found.

default_per_page.description: Page size for /admin/api/requests when the caller omits one.

admin.description: Admin console session store and provider-test panel.

session_ttl.description: Console session lifetime. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

challenge_ttl.description: Auth challenge lifetime; a nonce is single-use. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

max_sessions.description: Live console sessions kept before the oldest is evicted.

max_challenges.description: Outstanding auth challenges kept. The challenge endpoint is the only unauthenticated one, so its map is capped.

json_body_bytes.description: Largest admin API request body decoded.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-provider model catalog fetch timeout in seconds.

body_bytes.description: Cap on the model catalog response body.

test.description: Provider-test panel clamps. Served to the console through /admin/api/config.

max_tokens.description: Upper clamp for a provider test's max_tokens.

default_tokens.description: max_tokens applied when the test omits it. Must not exceed max_tokens.

default_timeout_seconds.description: Deadline applied when the test omits it; must sit between the floor and the ceiling.

default_prompt.description: Prompt pre-filled in the test panel.

poll_ms.description: Console poll cadence in milliseconds. Served to the bundle so the UI and server agree.

log_per_page.description: Request-log rows per page in the console.

audit.description: Request audit trail, written only when ROUTERLLM_DEBUG_ADVANCED and ROUTERLLM_LOG_FILE are set.

body_bytes.description: How much of any one body the audit trail keeps before marking it truncated.

render_bytes.description: How much of one body reaches the log; larger bodies are shown head and tail.

transport.description: Shared upstream HTTP transport. Startup-only: requires a restart.

max_idle_conns.description: Upstream transport idle connection pool size.

max_idle_conns_per_host.description: Idle connections kept per upstream host.

idle_conn_timeout.description: How long an idle upstream connection is kept. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

response_header_timeout.description: How long to wait for upstream response headers. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

tls_handshake_timeout.description: Upstream TLS handshake deadline. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

server.description: HTTP server and background tickers. Startup-only: requires a restart.

read_header_timeout.description: HTTP server request-header deadline. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

idle_timeout.description: HTTP server idle keep-alive deadline. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

shutdown_timeout.description: Grace period for in-flight requests on shutdown. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

metrics_prune_interval.description: How often expired metric buckets are pruned. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

watch_interval.description: How often routerllm.yaml is polled for changes. Go duration syntax (e.g. 30s, 5m, 168h).

admin_tls.description: Self-signed console certificate. Startup-only: requires a restart.

cert_validity_days.description: Validity of the auto-generated self-signed console certificate.

apiKey.description: API key(s). A string may be a ${VAR} environment reference; env values containing commas are split into multiple keys.

headers.description: Additional HTTP headers sent to the provider.

style.description: Provider API style: openai (passthrough), anthropic (translated to /v1/messages), cline (Cline account auth), google (translated to Gemini generateContent), alysis (Alysis gateway account auth), codex (Codex/ChatGPT account auth), opencode (OpenCode Zen account auth via `routerllm --opencode-login`: Console device flow, per-request access tokens, auto x-org-id, required-tool injection, rotating session/request headers), workbuddy (WorkBuddy account auth via `routerllm --workbuddy-login`: browser OAuth, refresh-token pool with singleflight refresh, desktop identity headers, fingerprint sanitize; base_url is the realm host — intl https://www.workbuddy.ai or CN https://copilot.tencent.com — and /v2/chat/completions is appended by the style), kilo (Kilo Code account auth via `routerllm --kilo-login`: OAuth device flow, long-lived token with no refresh, plain OpenAI passthrough to the Kilo gateway, per-account X-KILOCODE-ORGANIZATIONID; base_url https://ai-gateway.kilo.ai/api/v1).

base_url.description: Provider base URL: the upstream origin plus any gateway prefix. A trailing version segment (/v1, /v2, /v1beta) is optional and stripped, because each style appends its own versioned path; e.g. https://api.openai.com and https://api.openai.com/v1 are equivalent, and https://api.kilo.ai/api/gateway works as-is.

auth_mode.description: Authentication mode. none sends no auth header and needs no api_key (keyless local upstreams).

opencode_auth.description: OpenCode style only. login uses the account store and Console token exchange (default). anonymous sends the CLI's public placeholder credential with no account. bolt tries anonymous first, then falls back to login accounts for 60s after the gateway rejects anonymous. anonymous and bolt require OPENCODE_TLS_RELAY=1 (the Bun TLS relay) — the gateway only accepts anonymous traffic over that fingerprint.

reasoning_style.description: Reasoning dialect for openai-style providers: openai (reasoning_effort only), openrouter (reasoning map), qwen (enable_thinking/thinking_budget), raw (legacy passthrough).

share.description: Shared key group: providers with the same share value share keys and cooldown state.

query.description: Query string appended verbatim to every upstream request path, including the leading '?' (e.g. "?beta=true").

disabled.description: When true, this provider is skipped entirely and its api_key/credential validation is relaxed — use it to park a provider without deleting it.

reasoning_effort.description: Canonical reasoning effort: none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, or max (ultra normalizes to max). Re-emitted in the target provider's reasoning dialect. Only applied when the request doesn't already set a reasoning preference.

enable_thinking.description: false maps the route to effort "none" (thinking off); true defers to any explicit reasoning_effort.

provider.description: Provider name. Must match a provider defined above.

model.description: Upstream model name. Required — there is no fallback to model_id.

disabled.description: When true, this upstream route entry is skipped; other entries for the same model_id still serve it.

stylecall.description: Upstream API dialect for this leg: chat (/v1/chat/completions), responses (/v1/responses), or messages (/v1/messages). Empty or absent lets the provider style decide.

sanitize_tool_names.description: Normalize outbound tool/function names on this leg so strict upstreams accept them.

dedupe_tools.description: Drop duplicate outbound tool definitions on this leg, keeping the first occurrence.

clamp_tool_schemas.description: Flatten outbound tool schemas nested deeper than the top-level tool_schema_max_depth on this leg.

disabled.description: Park the whole chain: the model disappears from /v1/models and requests 404, while its yaml block (and every leg) stays intact.
